note: A paused run that fell back, recorded for VS4 of docs/model-credentials-routing (contract-pause.md C3, contract-table.md C1). Every value is invented: no installation is recorded here, and I2 replaces this file with what its end-to-end test records. `nodes` is a value per path the way fixtures/nodes.js records one, including the paths the database answers with nothing (null): the first is what the credentials service writes at paused/<slug>/<run>, the second is a run that never paused. `record` is the run's own result.json, whose stages[].fallback and cost.fallback_usd are C1's members -- the record is the runs bucket's and the phone cannot read it, so the test reads it here and nowhere else.
